about: Words the project adds to the 16:9 patch's overlay (work/boot.widescreen.json), chosen by rt_widescreen like the patch's own. tools/recomp/psp_analyze.py merges them only when the patch is there, and stops if a word in the program is not the one listed as orig. Each has the decompiled code that does the same (src/core/...), so the reference run and the decomp agree with WIDE FORCED on. Added code (caves) is assembled by hand (the source is in each entry's why and in tiles.c) and sits at 0x08800100, below the program: it is only translated, never loaded into game memory.

text.why: 0x08810D84's left limit: subu t2,zero,a3 (minus the cell width) -> addiu t2,zero,-96, as the patch does in 0x08811BCC (0x08811E28), so a fighter's parts are drawn into the left margin
0x088117D0's left limit: subu t0,zero,a1 -> addiu t0,zero,-96, the same
0x08821424 (an object drawn when on the screen): 64 to its left counted -> 112, so 48 more on the left
0x08821424, the same for an object fixed to the screen
0x08821424: within 0 - 511 -> 0 - 607, so 48 more on the right too
0x088214E8 (the same with the caller's margin): sll s1,a1,16 -> addiu s1,a1,48, then
sra s1,s1,16 -> seh s1,s1: the margin 48 more (as a halfword, as before), which widens both its tests by 48 each side
0x0881AB28's row start: the patch's jump into its cave 0x08A02F38, sent to AB28_START instead (2 tiles left, wrapped within the row)
0x0881AB28's wrap column: the patch's jump to 0x08A02F54, sent to AB28_WRAP
0x0881B268's row start: the patch's jump to 0x08A031B4, sent to B268_START (3 tiles left, wrapped within the row)
0x0881B268's wrap column: the patch's jump to 0x08A02ED0, sent to B268_WRAP

caves.name: AB28_START
caves.why: 0x0881AB28 (32-pixel tiles), each row's start in WIDE FORCED: x - 64 and the map pointer 2 words back, as the patch does; when the grid's first map column is 0 or 1, plus the map's width, so it wraps round within the row instead of reading the row above. Not the animated kinds 0xDA / 0xEE.

caves.name: AB28_WRAP
caves.why: 0x0881AB28: the column the row wraps across at, 2 further on as the patch has it, or 2 - the first column when wrapped round.

caves.name: B268_START
caves.why: 0x0881B268 (16-pixel tiles): the same, 3 tiles (48 pixels, 3 words), when the first column is 0 - 2 and the map wraps back by its own width (not the strips' kind 0x90, nor the animated 0x85).

caves.name: B268_WRAP
caves.why: 0x0881B268: the wrap column, 3 further on, or 3 - the first column when wrapped round.
